title: Order cancellation
subtitle: Cancel before shipment, refund if paid
capability: A customer cancels an order that has not shipped. The order is marked cancelled at once; if payment was captured, a refund is issued through the payment provider and the customer is told when it lands.
success: every cancelled paid order produces exactly one refund, and the customer sees the cancellation immediately

lanes.name: orders
lanes.summary: owns the order and its status

lanes.name: payments
lanes.summary: owns refunds; talks to the provider

steps.text: Opens the order and chooses Cancel, optionally giving a reason
Calls the cancel endpoint with the reason
Shows 'already shipped' with the carrier link; nothing changes
In one transaction: status CANCELLED, cancelledAt and reason set, and a refund job enqueued if payment was captured

fails.recovery: nothing changes; the browser shows a retry; the customer can try again

steps.text: Shows the order as cancelled; a refund notice when one is due
Claims the refund job with a lease; refunds through the provider with the order id as idempotency key

fails.recovery: another worker claims it; the idempotency key makes the second call a no-op at the provider

steps.text: Accepts the refund and returns a reference

fails.what: the provider is down or returns a retryable error
fails.recovery: the job retries with backoff for 24 hours, then goes dead and alerts
the job is dead with the provider's reason; support is alerted; the order keeps CANCELLED

steps.text: Records the refund reference on the order and emails the customer

guarantees.text: A cancelled paid order produces at least one refund attempt: the job is written in the cancelling transaction.
The provider refunds at most once per order: the idempotency key is the order id.
A shipped order is never cancelled here; the check and the status write share a row lock.
